nodes.title: Proposition 4.3 squared displacement (Ky Fan level)
nodes.notes:
RESTATED 2026-08-05.  The node used to point at `proposition4_3_squaredDisplacement_approximationNumbers`, pointwise domination of the individual approximation numbers.  That statement is FALSE: pointwise domination implies Ky Fan majorisation and hence Proposition 4.4, which this repository refutes (`shortRotation_fullDisplacement_refuted`, census row DK-4.4-prop).  Refuting configuration, computed: R^4, `U = span(e1,e2)`, `V` at principal angles pi/4 and pi/4 (acute), competitor carrying `U` onto `V` by a quarter turn in the V-frame and `U-perp` onto `V-perp` by the identity; then `a_2(1-D) = 0.765367 > 0.261052 = a_2(1-W)`.  Proposition 4.3 itself survives, because its Ky Fan sums are sums of SQUARES and those are dominated at every k.  The node now points at the Ky Fan form, which is what a unitarily invariant norm sees; it is still open.

RETARGETED 2026-08-27.  The node pointed at `TauCeti.DavisKahan.Frontier.Section4.proposition4_3_squaredDisplacement_kyFan` in the retired staging module `DavisKahan/Frontier/Section4.lean`; that wrapper was `:=` the stable theorem `TauCeti.DavisKahan.Section4.proposition4_3_squaredDisplacement_kyFan` in `DavisKahan/Geometry/Polar/DisplacementSquareExtremal.lean`, aliased source-facing as the declaration named here, so the statement is unchanged.  The Ky Fan form is PROVED; the closing sentence of the 2026-08-05 note above, written when the statement was still open, is superseded.  The refuting configuration for the pointwise reading is preserved in the `DisplacementSquareExtremal` module docstring.

nodes.title: Appendix to Section 6, item (d): common-domain sine theorem (complex)
nodes.notes:
Added 2026-08-08 so the required census row `DK-6-appendix` is mapped; this node names the arbitrary-unitarily-invariant-norm common-domain sine form over C.

SPLIT AND RE-GROUNDED 2026-08-11 (Claude Opus 5, coordinator, task #9 strand 2).  This node previously carried `open_obligation` with an empty dependency list, so its closure was 1/1 and the whole appendix row scored 0% -- while the sine half in both scalar fields, the tangent half at arbitrary trial dimension, and Lemma 6.3 were all compiled and axiom-clean.  The census row said so explicitly ('ALSO OVER-PESSIMISTIC ELSEWHERE: dev/davis-kahan-1970-frontier-status.md:35 scores this row at 0%').

ALL THREE REASONS THE FLAG CITED ARE DISCHARGED, each re-measured against the build rather than taken from the note.  (1) 'the tangent half is still InnerProductSpace C only' -- item (a) went real on 2026-08-11 (`theorem6_3_unboundedCompression_ideal_of_reducing_exists_real`) and item (b) the same day (`mem_and_gauge_le_reflectionTangentCorner_real`).  (2) 'Proposition 6.1 has no common-domain or unbounded form' -- `Proposition6_1_commonDomain` landed 2026-08-10 by an in-place RCLike generalization of `CommonDomainSymmetric.lean`, with `Proposition6_1_real_commonDomain` alongside.  (3) 'the unbounded double-angle tangent endpoint exists only at the operator norm, the Ky Fan nu >= 2 case being open' -- that endpoint is `mem_and_gauge_le_reflectionTangentCorner`, at every `KyFanDominantIdealFamily`, with the extremality hypothesis DELETED rather than discharged.

The four printed items now have a node each, both scalar fields where the row distinguishes them: (a) `s6-appendix-unbounded-compression{,-real}`, (b) `s6-appendix-tan2-kyfan{,-real}`, (c) `s6-appendix-prop6-1-common-domain{,-real}`, (d) this node and `s6-appendix-sine-real`.  Item (e), the displayed chain (6.7)-(6.11), gets NO node: it was adjudicated 2026-08-10 as proof steps internal to the paper's argument for (a), not statements the paper asserts, and the repository reaches (a) by a different route.  Companion declarations on the same row: `Theorem6_1_commonCore`, `Theorem6_2_real_commonDomain`, `Theorem6_2_real_commonCore`.

nodes.title: Appendix to Section 6, item (a): unbounded Ritz compression (complex)
nodes.notes:
Added 2026-08-11 (Claude Opus 5, coordinator, task #9 strand 2) as part of splitting `s6-appendix-unbounded`.  Item (a) is the paper's `A_0 <= alpha` and `Lambda_1 >= alpha + delta` with BOTH allowed to be unbounded, which is why the spectral resolution and the `Omega(tau)` truncation appear in the printed proof at all.  `UnboundedCompressionTrialData` has `compression` an unbounded self-adjoint `DKClosedOperator` and `residual` bounded; `ofBounded` makes the existing bounded `Theorem63TrialData` an instance, so nothing already proved gains a hypothesis.  The conclusion is `delta * N.gauge tanTheta_0 <= N.gauge residual` at every `KyFanDominantIdealFamily`, under a FORM bound (`SemiboundedAbove`) rather than a CLM norm bound.

The route was truncate-then-release, and the ordering is load-bearing: the fixed-cutoff theorem `all_kyFan_core_trunc` has a `tau`-FREE right-hand side, which is what lets the release run over `tau -> atTop` with unbounded levels.  SCOPE, stated honestly: the data layer abstracts `A_0` as a self-adjoint operator GIVEN on `Z`, exactly as `Theorem63TrialData` already did; deriving self-adjointness of `P_Z A|_Z` from an ambient `A` is the Rayleigh-Ritz/Friedrichs question and is NOT attempted.

nodes.title: Appendix to Section 6, item (a): unbounded Ritz compression (real)
nodes.notes: Added 2026-08-11 (Claude Opus 5, coordinator, task #9 strand 2) as part of splitting `s6-appendix-unbounded`.  Depends on the complex node because it genuinely IS a descent: the route was the trial-data transport of `DirectedUnboundedReal.lean`, NOT a real spectral cutoff.  The `Omega(tau)` cutoff in item (a) is the spectral cutoff of the Ritz compression ON THE TRIAL SPACE, so under transport it is applied to the COMPLEXIFIED compression, entirely inside the already-compiled complex `all_kyFan_core`; approximation numbers are preserved on the nose at the finite Ky Fan level, so the numerical conclusion descends.  The real module never mentions a real spectral cutoff.  A real `SpectralCutoffInterface` does exist (`DavisKahan/SpectralTheory/Real/SpectralCutoff.lean`) but is STANDALONE infrastructure -- item (a) did not need it, and the two must not be treated as coupled.

nodes.title: Appendix to Section 6, item (b): unbounded tan 2-Theta at every ideal (complex)
nodes.notes:
Added 2026-08-11 (Claude Opus 5, coordinator, task #9 strand 2) as part of splitting `s6-appendix-unbounded`, whose flag asserted that the unbounded double-angle tangent endpoint existed 'only at the operator norm, the Ky Fan nu >= 2 case being open'.  It has been at every `KyFanDominantIdealFamily` since 2026-08-10, over cutoff nets whose levels grow without bound.

THE EXTREMALITY HYPOTHESIS IS DELETED, NOT DISCHARGED.  `IsCompressedDoubleAngleEigenbasis` is a proved Ky Fan ATTAINMENT condition, so it can only hold with equality and must never be attacked directly; this endpoint removes it from the statement by routing through typed directed corners (`paperBlockCompression`) rather than the ambient `unboundedReflectionTangent`, which carries both adjoint corners and would risk double-counting the sharp 2.  Absence is verified by transitive constant closure with `allowOpaque := true` (56793 constants, with positive controls), NOT by grep -- the surviving textual hits are docstrings saying it is absent.

nodes.title: Section 1, (1.12)-(1.13): the Ky Fan norm as a supremum
nodes.notes:
Added 2026-08-09 (Claude Opus 5) so the required census row `S1-ui-norms` is mapped.  The row became required in the same edit that added this node: M38 proved (1.12) and both forms of (1.13), and on integration the row was set to `compiled_specialization` rather than the `compiled_exact` the mission recorded, which moved it off the terminal-status list.  Companion declarations on the same row: `equation1_13_compressions`, `equation1_13_reSum` (both exact, no narrowing), and the two projector-composition `<=` halves.  Marked an open obligation for one reason only, recorded as the row's `scope_gap`: `equation1_12` carries a codomain-room hypothesis that printed (1.12) does not, since (1.12) quantifies over projectors on the domain alone.  It enters through the proof -- the rectangular Ky Fan principle needs room for `nu` orthonormal vectors on both sides -- and it excludes an operator whose codomain has finite dimension below `nu`, a class the paper permits.  The removal route is worked out on the row's `next_action`; when it lands, this node stops being an open obligation and the row returns to `compiled_exact`.

FLAG CLEARED 2026-08-11 (Claude Opus 5, coordinator, task #9 strand 2).  This note said the flag was set 'for one reason only', the codomain-room hypothesis on `equation1_12`, and that 'when it lands, this node stops being an open obligation and the row returns to compiled_exact'.  Both happened on 2026-08-09 and the flag was left behind.  Re-measured: census row `S1-ui-norms` is `compiled_exact` with `scope_gap` opening '**No narrowing remains.**' and `next_action` 'Nothing outstanding.'  `equation1_12` now assumes only `hE : exists x : Fin nu -> E, Orthonormal C x` -- nonemptiness of the family the printed supremum ranges over, not an addition to the printed claim -- the codomain carries no hypothesis at all, `dim F < nu` is allowed, and no replacement hypothesis (`[FiniteDimensional]`, compactness, rank bound) was introduced.
